title: qa(checklist): re-point 36 stale identity-auth / ai / search / ux items to the product (batch A of #32908)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XFRXvtjswbXXeXcKr4e1uZW)_

Fixes #33328

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：平台测试清单 4 个区域文件(identity-auth / ai / search / ux-conventions)里 36 个条目的文字改成产品现在的真实行为，每条 revision +1 并加一行 history;另 2 条复核后本来就对，未动。
- 为什么改：v18.4.0 发版扫测(#32908)留下的过期文字，会让下一轮 QA 误判失败或照着失效的准备步骤白费时间。
- 风险与回滚：只改 `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/` 下 4 个 JSON,不碰产品代码；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`areas/identity-auth.json` 的 `idp-group-permission-set-mapping`(对照组改为推送前手工授权第二个用户)、`workspace-org-switch`(acceptance[5] 去掉没有界面入口的「界面报错」半句)、`ux-conventions.json` 的 `labels-over-machine-names`(按 #32106 裁决 A 豁免职位机器名)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:platform-checklist`,预期 `OK — 16 areas, 427 items`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Batch A of the #32908 close-out. Every row of #33328 was re-measured against the source at `82838e83` (current `origin/main`; the card's evidence was read at `87330e89`, and the 12 commits between touch none of the cited sources or the four area files). 36 items are re-pointed, each with one `revision` bump and one `history` row citing #33328, the QA record and its comment, and the source anchor. 2 items are already right and are untouched. No clause is loosened: where a clause's wording changed (workspace-org-switch acceptance[5], identity-import-wizard acceptance[0], session-list-revoke acceptance[0]), the change drops a half the product has no surface for or a count it never promised, and the oracle is unchanged.

Rows 240 and 241 were routed to this batch from #33331 (batch E) by the seat; they land on the same items as rows 244, 247 and 250.

## Tests

Checklist text only; no product code and no test changed. `pnpm check:platform-checklist` is the gate that reads these files (green below). Each edited item was checked after the edit by a JSON reparse: every other item byte-identical, each edited item's revision +1 and exactly one new history row with ref #33328.

## Acceptance notes

- Needs a live drive (left untouched): row 183's second half, "metadata:write alone answers -32601". It is a live reading of QA run #33081, and the item's variants[3] does not say what tools/list answers when nothing registers, so no text there is provably stale from source alone.
- Row 186's "perObject=0 accepted" is a fact (protocol-record-reads.ts clamps it to 1); the item claims nothing about 0, so it is recorded here only.
- Row 268's variants[6] half: the record read the decision on the expense record page, but the source opens the request's own record page, which is what variants[6] says. Left alone as already right; a run that lands elsewhere should file it against the console.
- No open question: every row is settled by source or by a recorded ruling.
